Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614103. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614103, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
